_comment: Tests this Linux tree is KNOWN to fail, each with the reason. collect-metrics reports them every run and fails only on a failure NOT listed here (or on a test run that exits non-zero naming no failing test). A listed test that passes is reported as 'known now passing' (remove its entry), never red: the hosted runner's fonts differ from a developer machine's, so these can flip between them. Names are `binary::test::path`. Entries may only LEAVE this list; add one only with a root cause, never to make a run green.

known.reason: macOS #997: expects Blink to unite the emoji's fallback face into a button's line (32 -> 39 px). Linux measures one FreeType run face (GlyphFace::Primary) and has no fallback-face line union.
macOS #997: pins the 32px bold `-apple-system` strut seat at 28; the family resolves to a different face and ascent on Linux (27).
The test sets Menlo 20px and expects a 10px advance; Menlo does not exist on Linux and the fallback face's advance differs.

macOS #992: the test fills the glyph atlas with CJK ideographs (U+4E00..) and asserts the atlas reset at least once. The hosted runner installs only fonts-dejavu-core and fonts-liberation, which have no ideographs, so no glyph ink is produced and the atlas never fills ('resets 0'). Passes where a CJK font is installed (a developer machine with Noto CJK). Fix options: install fonts-noto-cjk in the workflow, or make the test skip loudly without a CJK face.

macOS #1017 (E52): the test reads the shaped face from DisplayCommand::Text.run (`r.face.postscript_name`), a shaped-run record that only the macOS CoreText path produces; Linux text commands carry `run: None`, so the face reads as empty. Measured, not assumed: with only that face-name assertion skipped, the test passes on Linux, including its pixel checks (the static line's pixels unchanged across paint-only frames after another view paints; no relayout), so the E52 behaviour itself holds here.
